transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’ve been hearing voices… clear ones. Mostly in my apartment, sometimes in quiet museum rooms when no one’s there. It sounds like women whispering behind the walls, telling me which photographs belong in the archive.
Do you believe these voices are coming from real people behind the walls?
I don’t… I don’t see anyone. It just sounds like they’re behind the walls, whispering. It feels like they’re telling me which photographs belong in the archive.
Do you believe these voices truly know which photographs belong in the archive?
I… I don’t know if they truly know. It just sounds very clear, like women whispering from behind the walls, telling me which photographs belong there.
Have you been diagnosed with a brain or neurological illness?
Not that I know of… no one’s told me I have something like that.
Do you believe the voices are real people communicating with you?
I… I’m not sure they’re real people. I just hear them clearly, like women whispering behind the walls, telling me about the photographs.
Have you had a period where you felt unusually high, euphoric, or full of energy?

Sometimes… yes. I get days where I feel almost radiant, like I’ve been chosen for something. And if someone tells me to slow down or questions what I’m doing, I can get… very angry. Like they’re trying to erase me.
During those radiant times, do you need much less sleep than usual?
Yes… I don’t need much. Maybe two or three hours, and I’ll wake up before dawn feeling ready. Like sleeping would just get in the way of what I’m supposed to do.
Have you ever heard the voices during a time when your mood felt normal, not especially radiant or energized?

Yes… there was a stretch, maybe a few weeks, where I wasn’t feeling especially high or chosen or anything. I felt more… ordinary, I suppose. But I still heard the whispering in the apartment, and I still thought the arts people were watching my phone.
For at least one month, have you been hearing the voices or feeling that the arts people were watching your phone?
Yes. Longer than a month… about eight months, I think. The voices, and that feeling that people are watching my archive. It’s been there most of that time.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt deeply depressed or empty most of the day, nearly every day?
I… I don’t know. I’ve had low days, sure, but two weeks like that, nearly every day… I’m not sure I’d call it that.
During these past eight months, have there been times when you felt clearly high or energized for several days in a row?

Yes… there are days like that. I feel sort of radiant, like I’ve been chosen for something. And if people tell me to slow down or question what I’m doing, I can get… very angry. It feels like they’re trying to erase me.
During those radiant periods, do you become much more active than usual?
Yes… I do more. I’ll be up at night moving from labeling photographs to rewriting donor letters, then reorganizing boxes of programs. I don’t really sit still. It feels like there’s a motor in me.
During those radiant times, do you feel you have special powers or a special mission?

I wouldn’t call them powers, exactly. It’s more… I know I have a mission with the Caribbean archive. The museum board and the city arts people, they’ve been watching my phone because they know it could change how the galleries tell the truth. No one’s shown me anything that proves otherwise.
Have the voices been going on continuously for at least six months?
Yes… about eight months. The voices, and that feeling that people are watching the archive… it’s been there most of that time.
During one of those radiant, high-energy periods, were you ever hospitalized because of it?
I… I don’t really want to get into all that. I’m not sure what to say about being hospitalized for it.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you heard the voices or felt watched while your mood was not high, energized, or depressed?

Yes… there was a stretch, a few weeks at least, where I wasn’t especially up or grand or anything. But I still heard the whispering in my apartment, and I still felt like the arts people were keeping track of my phone.
During those radiant periods, have they ever lasted at least one week?
Yes… they lasted more than a week. It wasn’t just a day or two. Altogether those periods took up… maybe around six months.
Over these past eight months, have the high-energy or low-mood periods taken up most of the time?

Yes… I think so. Most of these months, since I retired, it’s been more of that driven feeling—like I was chosen for something, and I’d get irritable and couldn’t really slow myself down. There were quieter days too, when I kept to myself, but… most of it was like that.
